company.name: Bharat Electronics
company.tag: Builds radars, communication and electronic warfare equipment mostly for the Indian armed forces
products: Electronic voting machines, airport radars and rail signalling
company.productNote: Products named in Bharat Electronics' 2025–26 integrated annual report. It is a government-owned company that mostly sells to the Indian armed forces. Its joint ventures (with Thales and Israel Aerospace Industries) report separately. Pictures are annual-report photographs; the report does not caption the individual places, and three product pictures are labelled illustrations.
